The '''TT-15B Vanguard''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] used by both the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] such as both their soldiers and that of their [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] brethren during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. Mandalorian Medics and Commandos would use green versions of the armor during the [[war against Zakuul]] in the [[Raid on Darvannis]].
